planningBasis: Initial planning assumptions requested by the Business Owner. Dates and estimated hours are planning values, not actuals, and are intended to be adjusted as workshops, SME availability and implementation-partner sequencing become clearer.

001.milestoneOutcome: This permits us to understand our process
001.expectedOutcome: Fully mapped processes for Infasco, Infasco nut and DSI.

002.expectedOutcome: a full team, capacity determined for the value stream

streamTaskTemplates.title: Review pain points and classify ERP / pre-ERP / post-ERP
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: Current-state findings are converted into a controlled requirements backlog.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: All known pain points and opportunities reviewed, classified as pre-ERP / ERP scope / post-ERP, assigned an owner, and linked to a requirement candidate.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Define and prioritize business requirements and acceptance criteria
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: The value stream has a complete and prioritized requirement baseline.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Prioritized Must / Should / Could requirements with business rationale, acceptance criteria, process and entity scope, named owner, and identified SME gaps.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Approve value-stream design principles, entity variants and requirement baseline
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: Requirements and design principles are ready to enter To-Be design.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: BPO-approved requirement baseline and design principles for the value stream, with entity variants and unresolved decisions explicitly documented or escalated.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Design To-Be process and complete D365 fit / gap assessment
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: Approved requirements are translated into an executable D365 target design.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Approved To-Be process design for the value stream; each approved requirement has a D365 fit/gap disposition and impacted data, control, reporting and integration needs are identified.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Close material design decisions and approve To-Be / fit-gap
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: The value stream exits design with controlled exceptions only.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Material fit/gap decisions closed or escalated; extensions and customizations challenged; BPO design sign-off complete with residual exceptions documented.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Validate configuration, build, data, integration, reporting and control design
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: The configured solution is demonstrably aligned to the approved business design.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Business validation of configured solution/build against approved design; required master data, integrations, reports and controls mapped to owners with readiness evidence.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Complete business data, controls, reporting and integration readiness for SIT
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: The value stream is ready to enter integrated testing.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Data cleansing and validation, control/reporting definitions and integration readiness completed to the level required to enter SIT, with open exceptions explicitly accepted.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Execute critical end-to-end SIT scenarios
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: End-to-end solution behavior is proven for the value stream.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Critical end-to-end SIT scenarios executed with evidence; defects logged, prioritized, assigned and linked to the affected process or requirement.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Remediate and retest defects; recommend SIT exit
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: The value stream is stable enough to enter UAT.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Critical and high defects remediated or formally accepted; retesting complete; BPO recommendation for SIT exit documented.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Execute UAT and finalize work instructions and training
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: Business users can execute the future process and understand how to operate it.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Critical UAT scenarios executed by business; work instructions and training materials completed for impacted roles; issues are documented and owned.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Approve UAT and confirm business readiness
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: The value stream is business-ready before cutover readiness review.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: BPO signs off UAT and confirms people, process, data, control, reporting and support readiness, with residual exceptions formally accepted.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Complete value-stream cutover readiness checklist
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: All required value-stream cutover conditions are evidenced.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Value-stream cutover checklist complete, including final data, controls, reports, integrations, support ownership, contingency steps and accountable owners.

streamTaskTemplates.title: Document BPO readiness recommendation and residual risks
streamTaskTemplates.milestoneOutcome: December 2027 business readiness is formally evidenced.
streamTaskTemplates.expectedOutcome: Documented BPO readiness recommendation with residual risks, open exceptions and evidence supporting December 2027 business readiness.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Confirm master-data owners and current-state source inventory
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: In-scope master-data objects, current source systems, accountable owners and known quality gaps are documented for all entities.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Master data ownership and current-state scope are known.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Confirm quality SMEs and current-state quality / control touchpoints
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Quality SMEs, inspection/control touchpoints, nonconformance flows and critical quality data are identified across the in-scope processes.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Quality ownership and current-state control scope are known.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Define master-data governance, standards and ownership requirements
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Approved data governance, ownership, standards, naming, lifecycle and entity-variant requirements for all in-scope master-data objects.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Master-data principles are approved before detailed design.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Define quality requirements, controls and inspection model
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Approved requirements for quality planning, inspections, testing, nonconformance, corrective action, release controls and quality evidence.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Quality requirements and design principles are approved.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Design To-Be master-data model and migration rules
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Approved To-Be master-data model, ownership workflow, field mapping, entity variants, conversion rules and migration acceptance criteria.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: The future master-data model is ready for build and migration execution.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Design To-Be quality process and complete quality fit / gap
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Approved To-Be quality model covering quality orders, inspection plans, nonconformance, quarantine/release, corrective action and cross-company quality evidence.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Quality design is complete with material gaps resolved or escalated.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Execute data mapping, cleansing and migration rehearsals
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: All critical data objects mapped and cleansed; migration files validated through rehearsal cycles; owners approve quality thresholds and unresolved exceptions.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Data is ready to support SIT.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Validate quality configuration, master data and control evidence
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Quality configuration, specifications, inspection data, control roles and evidence requirements are validated and ready for SIT.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Quality configuration and data are test-ready.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Support SIT data cycles and remediate data defects
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: SIT data defects are corrected, migration rules are updated and test data quality supports successful end-to-end scenarios.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Data defects no longer block SIT exit.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Execute quality SIT scenarios and remediate defects
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Critical quality scenarios pass end to end; quality defects are remediated or accepted with evidence.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Support UAT data cycles and train data stewards
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: UAT uses validated data; data stewards are trained on ownership, creation, maintenance and quality-control responsibilities.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Master-data people and processes are business-ready.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Execute quality UAT and train quality / operations users
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Quality UAT passes and impacted quality/operations users are trained on future controls, evidence and exception handling.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Quality users and controls are business-ready.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Approve final migration data and data cutover readiness
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Final data loads, reconciliation approach, ownership, fallback and cutover responsibilities are approved for December readiness.
crossFunctionalTasks.milestoneOutcome: Master data is ready for cutover.

crossFunctionalTasks.title: Approve quality controls and cutover readiness
crossFunctionalTasks.expectedOutcome: Quality controls, roles, specifications, release authority, exception handling and support ownership are approved for cutover.

businessOwnerPatches.expectedOutcome: M-01 exit criteria, exceptions and residual ownership gaps are reviewed and formally approved or escalated.
Enterprise requirement priorities, design principles and material entity variants are approved for entry into To-Be design.
Cross-stream To-Be conflicts and material fit/gap exceptions are resolved or escalated with documented business decisions.
Material customization, integration, data, reporting and control exceptions are explicitly approved or rejected before SIT.
SIT exit recommendation is documented with critical defect disposition, residual risks and clear conditions for UAT.
Business UAT, training and operational-readiness sign-off is completed with residual exceptions documented.
Final go / no-go recommendation is presented to Steering Committee with current readiness evidence, residual risks and contingency actions.
Hypercare exit is approved and unresolved items are transferred to accountable business or support owners with benefits tracking established.

businessOwnerNewTasks.title: Approve December 2027 business-readiness baseline and residual risk acceptance
businessOwnerNewTasks.expectedOutcome: A consolidated December 2027 readiness baseline is approved, including value-stream sign-offs, residual risks, accepted exceptions and actions required before final go-live decision.
businessOwnerNewTasks.milestoneOutcome: Business readiness is evidenced by December 2027.

costTaskPatches.expectedOutcome: Approved Raw → Annealed WIP → Black WIP → Finished Goods inventory architecture with controlled decoupling points and ownership.
Approved governance for engineered, planned and standard cost versions, assumptions, refresh cadence, sign-off and bridge rules.
Controlled UOM, weight and piece-conversion architecture with accountable master-data ownership and migration rules.
Approved BOM, route, production-unit, resource-group, resource and cost-category hierarchy for D365.
Approved engineering and standard-setting basis for machine rates, setup, crew, yield and sustainable planning rates.
Approved design for capturing actual machine time, labor time, output, setup and scrap, including integration requirements where needed.
Approved standard overhead and normal-capacity methodology separated from actual spending and absorption analysis.
Approved actual cost-accounting model with causal allocation pools, drivers, ownership and period-end governance.
Approved D365 operating model for subcontract coating/external processing, including vendor resource, service, PO, receipt, invoice and price controls.
Approved Galvano legal-entity/site operating model with internal, intercompany or subcontract pattern explicitly selected.
Approved posting and variance design tracing operational events to WIP, inventory, COGS, PPV, production variances, scrap and absorption/spending analysis.
Approved cost-of-non-quality model linking scrap, sort, rework, deviation and corrective-processing costs to finance analytics.
Approved cross-company lot-genealogy design and reporting/integration pattern preserving group-wide traceability.
Approved standard-cost review, activation, effective-date and inventory-revaluation governance.
